specs.title: real map aggregates retain every geocoded request and share dashboard filters
map rejects unsafe viewport parameters and caps detail mode without truncating dense areas
desktop map shares filters, zooms clusters, supports keyboard exploration, and opens real request details
mobile map contains its controls, geography, feature list, and horizontal layout
slow street tiles do not block requests, and attribution stays visible when tiles load
street tile failure falls back without losing filters, details, or keyboard retry
a stalled street tile request times out to local geography and can recover
map has explicit loading, empty, error, and retry states without losing dashboard totals
local geography failure offers a working retry
delayed filter responses cannot restore old counts, markers, list items, or request details
delayed pan responses cannot overwrite a newer viewport
local API rejects invalid dates and a cursor reused with different filters
live API keeps complaint/date totals, daily counts, and keyset pages consistent
desktop renders live data, shared filters, keyboard chart, and reversible pagination
mobile keeps controls accessible and contains table scrolling within the page
loading state is explicit before the first API response
